item.title: Southern California beaches could soon a become national park
item.description: The National Park Service is officially investigating whether a massive stretch of the Los Angeles County coastline should be designated as a national park. The "Los Angeles Coastal Area Special Resource Study" targets a broad swath of the Pacific coast, including Pacific Palisades, Santa Monica, Venice, and Torrance.
